name: Visceratika — 1 Basic — Skin of the Chameleon

system.description:
Your skin takes on the color and texture of your surroundings, camouflaging you as long as you move no faster than a walking pace; faster movement blurs the effect into visible smears of color. In flight, this blends you almost seamlessly into the night sky, though you remain visible against structures like skyscrapers.

Spend a Blood Trait to activate. For the rest of the scene, anyone trying to spot you must win a Mental Challenge; unless they have Auspex, you gain four extra Traits in the contest (five if you're in flight against open sky).
